One important detail: Qi2.2 supports up to 25W, but the actual speed depends on your phone, temperature and battery level. Older iPhones generally max out at 15W, even with a 25W power bank.

Which one would I buy?

Everyday carry: Baseus PicoGo AM52.

Maximum sustained speed: Anker MagGo 2 Pro.

Budget under $50: INIU SnapGo.
